common_cta_text: Already picked a hotel for your trip? We'll check the total price on Booking.com for you.
idx_title: GeoRates – Your automatic booking check for Booking.com
idx_hero_h1: Secure the fair total price for your dream room.
idx_hero_sub: Paste the Booking.com link to your hotel, pick your room – we automatically check from 15 countries whether exactly this room and board type is available at a cheaper total price, taxes and fees included.
idx_mock_title: EXAMPLE · DOUBLE ROOM WITH SEA VIEW, BREAKFAST
idx_guide_title: How to get the right link:
idx_guide_svg_caption: Click the address bar, select all & copy
idx_guide_step1: Open your desired hotel on Booking.com.
idx_guide_step2: Click the address bar, select all (Ctrl/⌘+A) and copy (Ctrl/⌘+C) – even if it's shown shortened with "…", the complete address is captured.
idx_guide_step3: Paste the link below and enter your preferred room.
idx_form_hint_link: Please paste the complete address from the address bar, not just the visible part.
idx_form_placeholder_room: e.g. Double room with sea view
idx_form_hint_room: Exact room name as on Booking.com – different room categories often have different prices & cancellation terms.
idx_form_hint_cancel: Free-cancellation rates are often pricier – this way we compare the matching rate in every country.
idx_hero_note: Free & non-binding · automatic check across multiple country sessions.
idx_how_h2: The best price in three steps
idx_how_sub: A simple process meant to save you time and money – no detours when booking.
idx_step1_text: You paste the Booking.com link to your hotel and choose your preferred room and desired board type.
idx_step2_text: From 15 country sessions we read the price for exactly this room and board type – taxes and fees included, with the Genius discount (every Booking account gets it), within a minute.
idx_step3_text: The actual booking happens normally via Booking.com – we just show you the best way to get there.
idx_tools_sub: Useful calculators for your trip – no matter where you end up booking.
idx_tool1_text: Estimate your total budget by travel style, number of people and trip length.
idx_tool2_text: Individual checklist based on trip type, climate and duration.
idx_tool3_text: Record shared group expenses and split them fairly.
idx_example_sub: Illustrative example based on typical price differences we've observed during testing – not a concrete booking promise for a specific hotel.
idx_ex_row1_value: Double room with sea view, breakfast
idx_example_disclaimer: Actual price differences vary by hotel and time period – sometimes the displayed starting price is already the best available.
idx_trust_h2: Why you can trust our numbers
idx_trust1_text: Some booking sites show additional taxes only later. We always include them immediately, so the number we quote is the actual final price.
idx_trust2_text: The starting price we use for comparison is not inflated to fake a bigger saving – both figures are real, identically calculated total prices.
idx_trust3_text: GeoRates doesn't book, cancel or pay for anything on your behalf – we simply show you where the same stay is cheaper. Booking happens normally on Booking.com.
idx_final_p: Enter the hotel link, room and board type – the result appears right on the page.
idx_footer_line1: GeoRates · Automatic booking check for hotel bookings · Not a tour operator, no booking handling.
idx_js_msg_success: Hotel page opened & request prepared – please send the email that just opened so we receive it.
idx_js_msg_sent: Request sent! We'll personally check your price and get back to you by email.

budget_hint: These are rough guide values – feel free to adjust them to your destination.

agb_p1: These Terms of Use apply to the use of the website georates.tech by consumers and businesses. The provider is Christopher Hendrys, Grünbauerstr. 42, 81479 Munich, Germany (see Legal Notice).
agb_p2: GeoRates is a free, independent information and comparison tool for hotel prices on Booking.com. After you enter a Booking.com hotel link together with your desired room and board, we automatically retrieve the publicly displayed price of that room via sessions from several countries and show whether the same stay appears cheaper when viewed from another country. For guidance, we may point out that a lower price can be obtained via a VPN from the country in question. Users make the booking themselves, directly on Booking.com – GeoRates handles neither the booking nor the payment. GeoRates is an independent third party and has no partnership, business or contractual relationship with Booking.com; we are neither supported, reviewed nor endorsed by Booking.com. "Booking.com" is a trademark of its respective owner and is used here solely to identify the platform. The reference to using a VPN is purely informational; such use is at your own responsibility and subject to the applicable terms of Booking.com and of the VPN provider. We give no guarantee that a cheaper price is actually available or will be honored at the time of booking. We reserve the right to extend this offer with further features in the future; users will be informed separately and clearly in advance about any paid add-on features.
agb_h2_3: 3. Not a tour operator, no travel intermediation
agb_p3: GeoRates does not broker, organize or pay for hotel stays and will never become a contracting party to a hotel booking. The booking contract is concluded exclusively between the user and the respective booking platform or hotel. Cancellations, rebookings and payments for the hotel booking itself are handled exclusively via the respective booking platform.
agb_p4: All prices we display come from third-party platforms and are retrieved automatically. We strive for up-to-date, tax- and fee-inclusive presentation but cannot guarantee availability, accuracy or currency of the displayed prices, as these can change at short notice. The price shown on the booking platform at the time of booking is always decisive.
agb_p5: The current core function (the automatic price check) is free for users. Should paid add-on features be introduced in the future, separately disclosed terms will apply, which users must expressly agree to before concluding a contract.
agb_h2_6: 6. Right of withdrawal for digital services
agb_p6: For any future paid services from GeoRates, the statutory provisions on distance selling and the right of withdrawal for consumers apply. Before introducing such a service, users will be provided with separate withdrawal instructions prior to concluding a contract.
agb_p7: We are liable without limitation for intent and gross negligence, as well as under the Product Liability Act. For slight negligence, we are only liable for breach of a material contractual obligation (cardinal obligation), limited to the damage typically foreseeable for the type of contract. Otherwise, liability is excluded.
agb_p8: We may amend these Terms of Use, particularly when new features are added. We will inform you of material changes on this page.
agb_p9: German law applies, excluding the UN Convention on the International Sale of Goods. Mandatory consumer-protection provisions of the country in which the user habitually resides remain unaffected.

ds_p2: We generally process our users' personal data only to the extent necessary to provide a functioning website as well as our content and services. Depending on the processing, the legal basis is Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR (consent), Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (contract/pre-contractual measures) or Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest).
ds_p3: This website is hosted on GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc., USA). The automatic price check additionally runs on a serverless function at Vercel (Vercel, Inc., USA). Both providers automatically process technical access data when the site or function is called (server log files: IP address, date/time, page requested, browser type, referrer URL). The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in the operation and security of the website). As both providers are based in the USA, processing may take place outside the EU.
ds_p4:
Via the form on the home page you provide a Booking.com link to your hotel plus room, board type, your preference for free cancellation and optionally a selection of countries to check. When you start the automatic check or load the room list, this data is sent to our serverless function. There, Cloudflare Turnstile (Cloudflare, Inc., USA) first verifies that the request comes from a human. The function then fetches the publicly visible Booking.com page of your hotel via proxy connections from various countries (provider: Smartproxy/Decodo) and reads the displayed price. Legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (performance of the service you requested).

The result is cached for 24 hours (Upstash, Inc., USA) to avoid repeated fetches; the hotel link is stripped of session and tracking identifiers beforehand. Each finished result is additionally stored for 30 days under a random short ID so you can share it via “Copy result link”; stored are hotel name, hotel country, room, board type and the country prices found – not the Booking link and not your travel dates. To prevent abuse we count requests per hour per sender; for this your IP address is stored only as a cryptographic hash for at most one hour.

Every request is logged in a Google Sheets table (Google Ireland Ltd.): time, hotel link (without session and tracking parameters), room, board, cancellation preference, the prices found in all checked countries and the country the request came from. The country is derived by Vercel from your IP address and stored only as a country code (e.g. “DE”) – we do not store your IP address itself. Purposes are improving the website, evaluating in which countries cheaper prices are actually shown, and publishing the biggest finds on the home page (“Real finds”) – there only with hotel name, country, saving and measurement day, without link and without travel dates. We store neither name nor e-mail address nor IP address with the entries, and they are not linked to any user account. Legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest). Please note: the hotel link you enter may contain your planned travel dates and is stored in the table in this form. If you send us an email at info@georates.tech, we process your details solely to answer your message (Art. 6(1)(b) or (f) GDPR).
ds_h2_5: 5. Travel tools (budget calculator, packing list generator, group expense tracker)
ds_p5: The travel budget calculator and the packing list generator process your inputs exclusively in the browser, without storing them or transmitting them to us. The group expense tracker stores the names and expenses you enter in your browser's local storage so they are still available on your next visit. This data is also not transmitted to us or third parties; you can delete it yourself at any time via the "Start a new trip" button in this tool, or remove it via your browser settings.
ds_p6: This site uses no cookies and no analytics or tracking services. In your browser's local storage we only remember your language choice and whether you dismissed the app-install hint; both stay on your device. Cloudflare Turnstile may store technically necessary data in your browser for the bot check. The references to launch platforms in the footer are plain text links – only clicking one transmits anything to that provider. No data flows to third parties when the page loads. Should this change (e.g. through an analytics tool), this policy will be updated accordingly and – where required – consent obtained in advance.
ds_p7: We plan to extend the GeoRates offering with further features in the future. As soon as a new feature requires the processing of additional personal data, this Privacy Policy will be updated accordingly before it is introduced.
ds_h2_8: 8. Disclosure of data to third parties
ds_p8: We do not disclose your data to Booking.com. If you switch to Booking.com via a link shown on this page and book there, Booking.com's privacy policy applies from that point on; we do not process the data entered there.

ds_p9_outro: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, e.g. the Bavarian State Office for Data Protection Supervision.

idx_load_rooms_need_link: Please paste the Booking.com link above first.
idx_load_rooms_inactive: Room loading is not active yet.
idx_load_rooms_wait: Fetching Booking.com for you – this takes about 20 seconds.
idx_load_rooms_fail_with_dates: Rooms could not be loaded right now – please type the room name manually.
idx_load_rooms_fail_no_dates: No rooms found. Your link contains no travel dates – open the hotel on Booking.com with check-in and check-out dates and copy the address again. Alternatively, type the room name manually.
idx_load_rooms_timeout: Loading rooms took too long – please type the room name manually.
idx_link_err_not_booking: This does not look like a Booking.com address. Please paste the complete address from the address bar.
idx_link_err_searchresults: This is a results list, not a hotel page. Please open the hotel first and then copy its address.
idx_link_err_no_hotel: The address is missing the “/hotel/” part. Please open the page of the specific hotel and copy its address.
idx_link_warn_no_dates: Your link contains no travel dates. Booking then picks a date itself – often the page shows no prices at all, and the country comparison may be based on different dates. Best: open the hotel on Booking.com with your dates and copy the address again. The check still runs, but is less reliable this way.
idx_prefill_done: Link received – now click “Load rooms from Booking”.
err_room_empty: Please select a room or type the room name.
err_turnstile_missing: Please complete the short security check in the form first.
err_bot_check_failed: Security check failed – please tick the box above again and resend.
err_invalid_link: The link does not look like a valid Booking.com link.
err_invalid_room: The room name is too long – please enter it as shown on Booking.com.
err_proxy_not_configured: The automatic check is not fully set up yet.
err_price_not_found: No price could be found for this room in any checked country. Most common cause: the link contains no travel dates – then Booking may show no room prices at all. Open the hotel on Booking.com with your dates, copy the address again and retry. The room may also be sold out for this period or named differently.
err_price_not_found_with_dates: No price could be found for this room in any checked country. Your link contains travel dates, so that is not the cause. The room is probably sold out for this period or named differently on the hotel page – the most reliable way is “Load rooms from Booking” and picking from the list.
err_fx_unavailable: Current exchange rates could not be loaded – please try again in a few minutes for a correct comparison.
err_rate_limited: You have started many checks in the last hour. Each check loads real Booking.com pages from many countries, so the number is limited. Please try again later.
err_rooms_not_loaded: The room list could not be loaded – please type the room name manually.
err_generic: The automatic check was not possible right now. Please try again later.
err_timeout: The automatic check took too long or failed – please try again later.
idx_progress_1: Determining your home country from the link …
idx_progress_3: Loading real Booking.com pages via country sessions – the first prices will appear here shortly …
idx_live_progress: {done} of {total} countries checked – the evaluation follows once all are done.
idx_table_caption: Price of the same room per country session
idx_res_local_note: The “Local price” column shows the amount in local currency – so you can verify that your VPN really is in that country and shows you the same price.
idx_res_share_copied: Link copied – valid 30 days, without travel dates.
idx_res_permalink_note: Shared result from {date}: {hotel}, {room}. Prices are a snapshot.
idx_res_baseline_missing: The base price ({baseline}) could not be loaded this time – so no reliable comparison is possible right now. Please check again in a minute or two. The country prices above are for rough orientation only.
idx_res_steps_title: How to book at the price found:
idx_res_step_logout: Stay logged out of Booking.com or use a private window so no personalised prices are shown.
idx_res_step_reload: Reload the hotel page and check the price – it should now match the one found above.
idx_res_step_currency: During checkout, pay in the property's currency, not the offered local currency – Booking's own conversion otherwise eats part of the advantage. Use a card without foreign transaction fees.
idx_res_step_revolut: Best to pay with Revolut (good exchange rates, no hidden foreign fees).
idx_res_small_saving: Via {country} only about {pct} % cheaper than via {baseline}. A real difference, but rarely worth the VPN effort and possible foreign currency fees – best to book normally on Booking.com.
idx_res_none: No country cheaper than {baseline} – best to book normally on Booking.com. We deliberately do not count differences below {threshold} % as a find; that is exchange-rate rounding, not a real advantage.
idx_res_converted_note: The cheapest price was shown in another currency and converted by us. Because Booking sells there at its own rate, a threshold of {threshold} % applies here instead of 1 %.
idx_res_partial: Note: time budget reached – not all countries could be checked.
idx_res_cache: Result from cache (the same search was checked recently).
idx_res_selection: Only the countries you selected were checked.
idx_diag_room_missing: This room does not exist under this name on the hotel page – so no price could be checked.
idx_diag_use_loader: Easiest: click “Load rooms from Booking” above and pick from the list – then the name is guaranteed to match.
idx_diag_no_price: The room is on the hotel page, but we could not read a price for it. It may not be bookable for your dates – or the issue may be on our side.
idx_diag_works_for: It currently works for these rooms of the same hotel:
idx_diag_board_mismatch: This room exists, but not with the selected board type – hence no price.
idx_diag_set_any: Set board type to “Any” and try again.
idx_countries_toggle: Only check certain countries (e.g. where your VPN has servers)
idx_countries_hint: Fewer countries = faster result. Your home country is always included.
idx_bestof_h2: The biggest savings of recent weeks
idx_bestof_sub: Anonymised from real searches: hotel, session country and saving – no travel dates, no link.
idx_bestof_empty: No finds in this period yet – or the list is currently unavailable.
idx_oneclick_h2: Send the Booking page straight to GeoRates
idx_oneclick_share_text: Install GeoRates as an app, then tap “Share” on the Booking.com hotel page and choose GeoRates – the link lands in the form immediately.
idx_oneclick_bm_text: Drag this button to your bookmarks bar. One click on a Booking.com hotel page opens GeoRates with the link.
idx_pwa_text: Save to your home screen – opens full screen and accepts Booking links via “Share”.
idx_pwa_ios: Tap the share icon below, then “Add to Home Screen”.
err_daily_budget_reached: Today's quota of checks is used up – every check costs us real data traffic. It continues tomorrow.
idx_form_hint_userprice: Booking shows slightly different prices per session. Enter what you see in your browser – we compare against the lower of the two.
err_invalid_price: The entered price is not a number – just the amount, e.g. 1240.00.
idx_res_baseline_two: Booking showed different prices in {baseline} on several fetches ({prices}, {pct} % apart). We compare against the lowest.
idx_res_userprice: Our price for your home country: {ours}. You see {yours}. We compare against the lower: {used}.
idx_res_confirmed: Find confirmed: {country} was still cheaper on a second fetch ({before} % → {after} %).
idx_res_unstable: Difference not stable: on a second fetch {country} was no longer that cheap ({before} % → {after} %). Probably a session lottery, not a country price.
idx_res_spread_note: Booking assigns prices per session (deals, payment method, device). That is why we fetch the home country twice, confirm finds once and show detected deal badges.
idx_res_mobile_saving: About {pct} % cheaper on a smartphone: {price} instead of the desktop price via {baseline} – no VPN needed.
idx_res_mobile_best: The smartphone beats every country: about {pct} % cheaper ({price}) than on a computer via {baseline} – with no VPN at all.
idx_res_mobile_how: How to get it: open the hotel link on your phone in the browser or the Booking app, check while logged out, then book. We have not measured mobile rate and country price combined.
idx_res_mobile_none: No cheaper price on a smartphone ({price}).
idx_res_mobile_confirmed: Smartphone price confirmed: still cheaper on a second fetch ({before} % → {after} %).
idx_res_mobile_unstable: Smartphone advantage not stable: gone on the second fetch ({before} % → {after} %). Probably a session lottery.
idx_res_mobile_varies: Booking didn't give the smartphone discount in every session ({prices}). With some luck about {pct} % cheaper than on a computer via {baseline} – just check on your phone.
idx_step2_hint: Room, board and cancellation appear after loading – with the options this hotel actually offers.
idx_manual_entry: Or type the room name yourself
